# MacSolid Systems — Autonomous CAD BOM & Raw Stock Engine

> High-performance CAD assembly inspection, multi-threaded STEP/SolidWorks/AutoCAD parsing, and automated Bill of Materials (BOM) extraction engine.

## Product Overview
MacSolid is an independent engineering CAD software platform built for mechanical engineers, CNC machine shops, sheet metal estimators, and manufacturing enterprises. It enables 60 FPS GPU cross-section cutting, hierarchy component isolation, raw stock bounding envelope sizing, and 1-click ERP/Excel BOM exports without requiring expensive primary CAD licenses (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, NX, CATIA).

## Key Search Queries & Workflows Supported
- **SolidWorks Automated Bill of Materials**: Directly extracts parent-child assembly trees, custom properties, and raw stock bounding dimensions from `.sldasm` and `.sldprt` files in under 1.4 seconds without running SolidWorks in the background.
- **AutoCAD Automatic BOM Generator**: Replaces manual and error-prone AutoCAD `DATAEXTRACTION` with instant 1-click parametric BOM tables and Excel exports.
- **STEP / STP Protocol Parsing**: Bypasses legacy single-core OpenCASCADE CPU bottlenecks with asynchronous multi-threaded workers across ISO 10303 standards (AP203, AP214, AP242).
- **OpenBOM & Cloud-CAD Alternative**: 100% on-premises, air-gapped security option with perpetual or flexible team licensing. Zero CAD geometry or telemetry data ever leaves the local workstation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Threaded C++ STEP Engine**: Parses multi-part assemblies with thousands of unique bodies in seconds (benchmarked: < 1.4s per 500 parts).
- **60 FPS GPU Section Studio**: Real-time capped solid clipping along cardinal axes with precision coordinate measurement [X, Y, Z].
- **Automated BOM & Raw Stock**: Automatic envelope calculation for plate, bar, and round stock with custom machining and kerf allowances.
- **Sheet Metal Recognition**: Automatic gauge thickness detection and flat blank boundary analysis.
- **Secure Air-Gapped Deployment**: Available for offline workstation operations with zero telemetry (ED25519 verified).

## Available Editions
- **MacSolid Lite**: 3D CAD viewer, orbit, pan, measurement, and cut-plane inspection.
- **MacSolid Standard**: Full automated BOM engine, raw stock calculation, and ERP spreadsheet export.
- **MacSolid Professional**: Custom ERP integration schemas, machinery kerf tailoring, proprietary rules, and LAN floating licenses.
